component.name: ScrollAnimItem
component.script:
sub init() m.bg = m.top.findNode("bg") m.label = m.top.findNode("label") m.top.observeField("itemContent", "onItemContent") m.top.observeField("itemHasFocus", "onItemHasFocus") end sub
sub onItemContent() if m.top.itemContent <> invalid m.label.text = m.top.itemContent.title end if end sub
sub onItemHasFocus() if m.top.itemHasFocus m.bg.color = "0x4488CCFF" else m.bg.color = "0x223344FF" end if end sub
